findings.rule: A gate must not be documented as enforcing more than the pinned implementation checks
findings.trigger: The new sentence states that every command CI runs must be reachable from a recipe, but the pinned recipes-check only matches three literal invocation shapes while scanning .github/workflows (bootstrap.go <cmd>, cmd/ledger-tool [--root] <cmd>, @ledger-tool <cmd>; internal/governance/recipes.go:25-29), and it silently returns an empty command set when .github/workflows is absent (recipes.go:171-174). Reproduced in a /tmp scratch copy: adding 'run: go run ./tool/bootstrap.go --root . totally-unknown-probe' to .github/workflows/ci.yml leaves recipes-check at exit 0, while the same step without --root fails with 'CI runs totally-unknown-probe but no just recipe reaches it'; moving the .github/workflows directory aside also leaves exit 0
findings.impact: A workflow can enforce a gate that no recipe reproduces, or invoke a command the policy does not define, while the documented agreement check still reports success. The ledger workflow currently uses only the recognised bootstrap.go form, so the gap is latent rather than an active weakening of this repository's gate
findings.recommendation: Either narrow the sentence to the entrypoints actually inspected, or extend the detector in ledger-tooling to tolerate --root/absolute-root invocations and to make an absent .github/workflows explicit instead of a silent empty set, then re-export and re-pin the bundle in both consumers

findings.rule: The skills-check guarantee stated for this repository must match the enforced invariant
findings.trigger: Carried over unresolved from the previous round: the same line still says skills-check requires every shared skill under .agents/skills to match the bundle template byte for byte, 'so a repository cannot quietly document a different procedure', while SkillsCheck iterates the bundle templates and never enumerates the consumer skill directory (internal/governance/skills.go:24-63). Reproduced in a /tmp scratch copy of the App: replacing the consumer-only .agents/skills/ledger-ui/SKILL.md procedure with a contradictory instruction leaves skills-check at exit 0, while appending one line to the templated ledger-debug copy fails with 'skill copy has drifted from the pinned template'
findings.impact: A consumer-only skill can describe a different procedure and still pass the gate, so the documented assurance is wider than what is enforced. This repository owns only the two templated skills (ledger-architecture-review, ledger-debug), so the current exposure is the wording rather than an existing unreviewed procedure
findings.recommendation: Adopt the producer wording (every template in the pinned bundle must exist at .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md byte for byte, and additional consumer-only skills are allowed), or ship a bundle template for each repository-owned skill
